snippet.title: Fine Work Announcement Trailer 2023
snippet.description:
This video features gameplay from the pre-release demo of Fine Work: Act I! We hope you enjoy seeing all the updates and changes we've made since! 

Fine Work: Act I is available now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2752240/Fine_Work_Act_I/ 

---

We're so excited to announce our first studio title - Fine Work! Fine Work is an upcoming science-fantasy visual novel with a unique rhythm game at its heart. Visit us at fine.work & follow along to meet the cast, see dev updates, & more!

Stay Vivid!
